description: Read Backsies backup status for a hosted website (availability, active run, last backup, space used by this site and the account against the storage limit). Pass runId to read one run; add waitSeconds (max 50) to wait until it finishes.

domain.description: Site domain, e.g. example.fi, instead of serviceId.

runId.description: Read one backup or restore run (runId from the confirm).

serviceId.description: OMA hosting service id. Pass this or domain.

waitSeconds.description: With runId: wait up to this long for the run to finish.

name: oma_backsies_status
title: Backsies status
